reason: Slack free plus our shared Notion already works and costs us nothing, and half our coordination is voice notes anyway. I might poke at the free trial myself, but I'm not dragging my partner into a third app migration for $20 a month.
objection: Getting my partner to switch is the real cost, not the $20. If they don't move their whole day into it, I'm just keeping two systems in sync, and I don't see voice notes mentioned anywhere.
would_change_my_mind: My partner getting fed up with Slack and Notion first and asking to switch, plus an easy import of our Notion docs and tasks and proper voice notes in the chat.
